payload.description: Local images are built on Apple Silicon, producing linux/arm64. Managed cloud Kubernetes nodes are typically linux/amd64, so current images will fail at pull/exec on the production target. Add a docker buildx multi-arch (or explicit --platform linux/amd64) build path for plexus-worker and the private GraphQL proxy. Keep the local kind flow on native arch for speed; the amd64/multi-arch path is for registry-published images. Validate by building both architectures and running the scoring import smoke test under emulation or on an amd64 host.
payload.title: Build linux/amd64 worker and proxy images alongside local arm64
